rawDescription: Multi-user AI agent platform built on Spring Boot with Vue 3 frontend. Features include digital employees with ReAct + Plan-and-Execute reasoning, LLM Wiki knowledge management, MCP/ACP tool integration, multi-vendor AI provider failover, workflow orchestration, RBAC security, and multi-channel support (web, desktop, IM).
readmeHead: MateClaw: Your second brain — Agent Harness · Spring Boot inside · One JAR to ship
languagesNarrative: MateClaw uses Java 21 as its primary backend language with Spring Boot 3.5, Vue 3 + TypeScript for the admin SPA, and SQL for Flyway-managed database migrations.
